purpose: Prevent premature testing of a high-turnover cross-sectional predictor on today's surviving assets.

primary_source.citation: Guo, Sang, Tu and Wang (2021), Cross-cryptocurrency Return Predictability
primary_source.reported_result: Adaptive-LASSO long-short portfolios on Binance futures were reported profitable out of sample after stated transaction costs at slower intraday rebalance intervals.
transfer_risks: the futures test is based on a short 2021 sample
the reported top-30 universe is not reconstructed point in time in the current project
market structure and Binance fee/execution conditions have changed
the model has high turnover and is especially sensitive to latency, spread, slippage, and feature timestamping

activation_requirements.membership_lag: use only the prior sealed daily universe snapshot
activation_requirements.return_data_before_activation: must not be downloaded, analyzed, or summarized for strategy performance
publisher_bound_inputs: Binance USD-M aggTrades needed for execution replay
all instruments selected by historical snapshots, including later-delisted contracts
activation_requirements.execution_policy: Base cost is 5 basis points all-in per unit of realized turnover per fill, including trading fee; do not add the fee twice. A flat entry plus flat exit therefore costs at least 10 basis points. Stress cost is 10 basis points per fill, or 20 basis points for a flat round trip. No VIP discount or maker fill credit is allowed without matching forward execution evidence.

limitations: the calibration covers public-L2 long-entry observations from one temporal window
long exit, short entry, short exit, protective stops, strategy-trigger latency, and market impact remain unmeasured
the stress floor is not permission to trade live

holding_and_rebalance_policy.decision_information: only returns from fully closed one-minute bars through decision minute t
holding_and_rebalance_policy.entry: first executable price at or after the t+1 minute boundary; the mandatory one-minute latency buffer forbids a fill inside decision minute t
holding_and_rebalance_policy.exit: close the whole cross-sectional portfolio 13 minutes after entry before forming the next portfolio
holding_and_rebalance_policy.diagnostics: record 1-minute, 5-minute, and 13-minute markouts, but only the preregistered non-overlapping 13-minute portfolio may determine the gate
holding_and_rebalance_policy.rationale: the one-minute forecast is ranked cross-sectionally and held for the paper-motivated 13-minute interval solely as a fixed cost-amortization transfer assumption

activation_requirements.model_policy: The exact predictor, training window, regularization selection, rebalance interval, latency buffer, portfolio weights, and costs must be preregistered before return archives are acquired.
activation_requirements.sample_policy: The first 120 consecutive universe days are development and the final 60 are locked validation; validation returns remain unread unless all development gates pass.
activation_requirements.live_policy: Even a locked-validation pass is only a sleeve candidate and must still pass portfolio monthly-return, MTM drawdown, ruin, bias, execution, and concentration gates.

prohibited: registering Experiment 0015 before every activation requirement passes
testing the paper's model on only BTC, ETH, BNB, SOL, and XRP
constructing past membership from today's listed symbols
choosing a rebalance interval after observing net returns
using the paper's historical transaction-cost assumption instead of current measured costs
using leverage to target 10% monthly returns
